cases.input: A rule derogation is granted for one application and environment until a fixed date.
cases.expect: Subject, rule, scope, owner, authority and expiry are retained.

cases.input: A valid grant is renewed with new conditions.
cases.expect: A new linked grant is created.
Operational exception state ends while history remains.

cases.input: The grant changes violated to satisfied.
cases.violates: An exception never rewrites assessment outcome.

cases.input: A grant has no expiry or accountable owner.
The grant is treated as residual-risk acceptance.
cases.violates: Residual-risk acceptance requires a separate decision.

cases.input: A grant pins one standard expression and enumerates three rules, all of which resolve under that expression.
cases.expect: The grant is accepted with every derogated rule resolving under the single pinned expression.
cases.violates: Each exception pins one exact standard expression.

cases.input: One grant enumerates rules belonging to two different standard expressions.
cases.expect: The grant is rejected; separate grants are required per standard expression.
cases.violates: Each exception pins one exact standard expression.

cases.input: A derogation spanning two standards is recorded as two grants sharing subject and scope and linked as co-grants.
cases.expect: Both grants are accepted, each independently expirable and revocable.
cases.violates: (added:) A derogation spanning two standard expressions is recorded as co-grants, not as one grant.

cases.input: An expiring grant is renewed with tightened conditions.
cases.expect: A new grant identity is created with renewalOfRef, and the predecessor closes as expired.

cases.input: The predecessor grant is set to a renewed state and its validUntil is moved forward.
cases.expect: The edit is rejected; renewal is never an extension of one identity.
cases.violates: (added:) No grant enters a renewed state and no effective grant's validUntil is edited.

cases.input: A renewal's validFrom is dated before its predecessor's effective end, over the same subject, scope and rule.
cases.expect: The renewal is rejected; concurrent effective grants over the same rule are not permitted.
cases.violates: (added:) A renewal's validFrom is not earlier than its predecessor's effective end.

cases.input: A grant names a granting authority, an assessing party and a subject owner that are three different parties.
cases.expect: The grant is accepted with three-party distinctness recorded.
cases.violates: (added:) Granting authority, assessing party and subject owner are three distinct parties.

cases.input: The party that performed the conformance assessment also grants the exception.
cases.expect: The grant is rejected for role collapse.
cases.violates: (added:) No party holds two of these roles on one grant.

cases.input: A grant is issued before any assessment cites it, and a later retest fails the derogated rule.
cases.expect: The grant remains effective until expiry or revocation, unaffected by the failed retest.
cases.violates: (added:) A grant's validity is independent of any assessment.

cases.input: A grant is voided on the grounds that no assessment cites it.
cases.expect: The voiding is rejected; grant validity does not depend on a citing assessment.
cases.violates: (added:) A grant's validity is independent of any assessment.

cases.input: Residual risk for a derogation is accepted through a separate decision under the rationale, occurrence and issued-record triad.
cases.expect: The acceptance is referenced by the grant and stored outside it.
cases.violates: Residual-risk acceptance requires a separate decision.
